recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, back-lit figure in motion against a dark, grainy background, characterized by high-contrast rim lighting in cyan and orange, framed by a horizontal rule and a central script title.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure's cyan rim light contrasts against the deep magenta-red glow in the lower-left.
The horizontal black line bisects the top third, anchoring the script title.
Symmetrical blocks of sans-serif text flank the central figure's head.
The small-scale town silhouette at the bottom provides a sense of scale and narrative context.
coreInvariants: Strong back-lighting (rim light) defining the silhouette.
A mix of script and clean sans-serif typography.
A limited palette of cyan, magenta, and black.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-shot of a person, angled away from the viewer, occupying the central 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central script title positioned at the top-center, breaking a horizontal rule.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the upward tilt of the figure's head, then move outward to the flanking text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space on the right side balances the vibrant magenta glow on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background with heavy grain.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/light blue rim lighting on the figure's shirt and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta-red glow behind the figure and orange highlights on the portable music player.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright rim light and the dark shadows; high saturation in the magenta glow.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script for the main title; geometric sans-serif for secondary text.
letterConstructionRules: Title script features a consistent 45-degree slant, fluid connections, and varying stroke weight.
Secondary text uses a clean, uppercase-only geometric skeleton with wide tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' in the script has a long, sweeping horizontal bar that integrates with the layout's rule line.

composition.position: upper left and upper right quadrants

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of expressive, organic script with rigid, mechanical sans-serif.

preserve: The horizontal line breaking through the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s hand-drawn energy of the main title.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast needed for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a person in a white t-shirt and dark pants, seen from the back-side, looking up. Use strong cyan rim lighting and a large magenta-red circular glow in the bottom left. The background should be dark charcoal with heavy film grain. Include a tiny silhouette of a rural town at the very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal black line across the top third. Place a large, black, slanted script title centered over the line. Flank the subject's head with two blocks of small, uppercase sans-serif text in alternating magenta and light grey colors.

verificationChecks: Is there a heavy grain texture?
Does the script title break the horizontal line?
Is the secondary text uppercase and geometric?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact handwriting of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the grainy background.
Check that the cyan rim light is the brightest point on the figure.
Verify the horizontal rule is perfectly straight.
Confirm the magenta glow does not overpower the central figure.
recipe.reuseFormula: Airbrush Subject + Rim Light + Grainy Dark Background + Script Title/Rule Combo + Flanking Sans-Serif Blocks
